title: Finite-exponent norm under coercion
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a nonnegative real number $q$, and a function $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, the extended-exponent uniform norm at the coercion of $q$ to the extended nonnegative reals equals the uniform $q$-norm.
